bole.text: Small trunk, 15-20 cm wide, cylindrical and regular; thick branching along the bole.

crown.text: Dense but narrow crown of dark green foliage, branched thickly along the bole; an occasional understorey evergreen (Manuel Antonio).

phenology.flower_colour: white (tiny translucent petals, pale sepals), in axillary racemes to c. 10 cm
phenology.fruit: dry woody green spherical capsule c. 1 cm, covered in small protuberances; splits in 6, releasing 3 brown seeds

bark.text: Smooth; freshly peeled bark smells strongly of menthol or pine.

habitat.range: Mexico to Bolivia, Venezuela, the Guianas and Brazil; in Costa Rica widespread in humid forests on both the Atlantic and Pacific slopes

notes: Height: Flora de Costa Rica (src 2) gives 'arbusto o árbol de 8 a 15 (24) m'; crtrees.org (Manuel Antonio) gives 10-15 m and calls it an occasional understorey tree; Osa Arboretum says small to mid-sized. Flora de Costa Rica refused direct fetch (HTTP 403), so its values (height, elevation 20-850 m, leaves 4-26 x 2-10 cm, broad-elliptic to elliptic-oblong, petioles without glands, lepidote indument, leaves drying dark brown, range to Bolivia, the Guianas and Brazil) come from search-engine excerpts of that page. The habitat elevation is from src 2; the rest of the habitat block is from crtrees ('light-loving secondary forest species' in gaps, streambanks and roadsides), and the Costa Rica slopes are from Osa. Phenology is for Pacific Costa Rica (crtrees): flowering irregular, almost any month except May-Jul, with short synchronised peaks Dec-Apr (the months listed); fruit at low levels year-round. Osa Arboretum lists flowering and fruiting in every month, white flowers and greenish aromatic fruit. Leaf texture 'papery' maps crtrees' 'thin and flexible'. eaten_by is empty because no source names a fruit eater; crtrees says the fruits fall directly to the forest floor and are poorly dispersed. Pollinators are bees and wasps. The trunk diameter of 15-20 cm is used as dbh.
